text.tspan: * Historical Vetting [SCI 2025] is aggregating 24 criteria that cover the years
2010, 2015, 2020, and 2025 for 6 variables. The individual criterion outcomes
are either 'ok', 'failed', or 'N/A' and can be accessed in the SCI meta-indicators.
